title: A harvest lot, as its holder counted and weighed it: how many plants were harvested into the lot, the weight when cut and the weight when dried. The count is a whole number. Weights are whole grams. The numbers are the holder's own statement on the date the record was sealed; nobody measured them for the holder. Which lot, from which batch and of what is in the record the numbers are sealed with, not here. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
